d: Short, messy, platinum white hair with jagged bangs frames a mature face with a smug expression and narrow, olive-green eyes behind thin-rimmed glasses. The slender build is dressed in a white blazer over a black shirt with a white tie, paired with light grey trousers and black dress shoes, all draped by a long, burnt-orange coat worn over the shoulders. The look is completed with white gloves, a black top hat held in one hand, and a black rectangular placard with white cursive text. BODY COLOR: Pale LEGS: Plantigrade, wearing black leather dress shoes.
